assets.promptExact: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE new production pixel-art enemy sprite for DEAD SECTOR retro first-person horror game, genuinely transparent PNG, square canvas. Input image 1 is IDENTITY AND LOW FRAMING REFERENCE ONLY: adult female crawler with long black hair, dirty ivory Victorian long-sleeved nightdress, pallid skin, crawling on two hands and two bent legs. Input images 2 and 3 are PIXEL ART STYLE REFERENCES. Create a better newly drawn base idle pose of this crawler matching the hand-pixelled chunky clusters, stepped edges, matte shading and muted dirty ivory/blue-grey skin of those male zombies. This is a full body game sprite, not an illustration. Front-facing low hunched quadruped approaching viewer, shoulders and humped back low, head hanging between shoulders, black hair partially veiling a cadaveric face with small pale eyes, threatening subtle slack mouth (no broad cartoon grin). Both complete long thin hands splayed firmly on ground, two bent knees/feet visible behind, exactly two arms and two legs. The nightdress drapes between knees. Same frontal camera as image 1. Maintain generous transparent upper area and 4% side margins. Composition in normalized square: silhouette spans x=5%-95%, y=33%-98.4%; head centered x=50%, face around y=51%-61%; both hands grounded near y=98.4%. Ground anchor center (50%,98.4%). Output ideally 1024x1024; downstream whole canvas will be reduced to512x512, no recropping. Pixel clusters must read at 60-140px display, restrained detail, broad diffuse shading, no glossy smooth rendering or photographic skin. No floor, no ground shadow, no puddle, no particles, no labels, no text, no grid, no border, no background. Empty regions truly alpha transparent. One base idle pose only.

transformations.resampling: NearestNeighbor, whole square canvas, true alpha preserved
